fusions.name: Gauntlet Hold
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in an iron grip, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gage Flung
fusions.desc: Flings a mailed gauntlet that deals 5 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 6 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steadying Hold
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from the ally who needs it most.

fusions.name: Hands Under
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, healing you receive rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
